_doc: Rebuild T4b position table, transcribed from t4b_extraction/cluster_NN.json (verbatim quotes and pointers there). Units: arcmin unless stated. 'status' gives the mechanical reason when a cluster lacks a required position or per-position 1-sigma error (PREREG 5.5 item 5). Decisions per DEVIATIONS_REBUILD.md D10.
